input.quote: (c) ASSIGNMENT. Licensee may not assign this Agreement or assign, sublicense and/or transfer in any manner its license rights hereunder in whole or in part without Licensor's prior written consent.
input.rationale: Two walk-away features: (i) Article XXIV(c) imposes a blanket prohibition on any Licensee assignment with no affiliate or M&A carve-out (and no reciprocal restriction on Licensor, who may assign freely, including to our competitors), and (ii) Article XX(a) makes any Change of Control of Licensee an automatic termination of the Agreement and of all our licences, subject only to Licensor's consent, which Licensor is deemed reasonable in withholding on broad self-interest grounds. This fails the fallback (no mutual successor-assignment right) and is expressly walk-away territory. We therefore move to the preferred position: affiliate and successor assignment without consent for Licensee, Licensor assignment only with our consent (not unreasonably withheld) and never to a Licensee competitor, and no Licensor termination right on our Change of Control. Consent remains required for other Licensee assignments, and the Change of Control definition is retained for the amended Article XX(a).

proposal.summary: Add Licensee affiliate/successor assignment rights, restrict Licensor assignment, and remove automatic termination on Licensee Change of Control.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We need to be able to assign to an Affiliate or to a successor in an M&A transaction without consent, and a change of control of Licensee cannot terminate this Agreement or our licences. We have also made Licensor's assignment subject to our consent (not unreasonably withheld) and barred assignment to a competitor of Licensee.

Any attempt to assign this Agreement or assign, sublicense and/or transfer in any manner Licensee's license rights hereunder without such consent will be void and of no effect.
ops.newText: Licensee may assign this Agreement without Licensor's consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of all or substantially all of its assets, and may otherwise assign, sublicense and/or transfer in any manner its license rights hereunder in whole or in part only with Licensor's prior written consent. Licensor may not assign this Agreement without Licensee's prior written consent, which will not be unreasonably withheld, and may never assign to a competitor of Licensee.

ops.oldText: (a) Upon the occurrence of any Change of Control (as defined below) this Agreement and all Licensee's rights and licenses hereunder shall automatically terminate unless, prior to the occurrence of such Change of Control, Licensor has consented to such Change of Control in a writing executed by an officer of Licensor; provided that Licensor will not unreasonably withhold its consent to the consummation of a Change of Control. For purposes of the preceding sentence, Licensor will be deemed to have reasonably withheld its consent to a Change of Control if any person or entity who would acquire direct or indirect control (as defined below) of Licensee pursuant to such Change of Control then conducts a business that is directly or indirectly competitive with a business then conducted by Licensor or any of its Affiliates and/or Licensor reasonably believes that Licensor's interests will be adversely effected by the continuing of this Agreement upon such a Change in Control.
ops.newText: (a) No Change of Control (as defined below) shall give Licensor any right to terminate this Agreement or any of Licensee's rights or licenses hereunder.
